concerns.text: Phase 0 (Environment) is listed in the plan but no functional requirement (FR‑XXX) or success criterion (SC‑YYY) in the spec references it; the spec does not mandate any environment‑setup tasks, so this phase is an over‑reach.

Phase 8 (Validation & Contract Enforcement) appears in the plan without any corresponding FR or SC in the spec; while useful, it is not required by the specification and therefore constitutes unnecessary scope.
